continuity: The Emperor publicly declares Prince Shangshan his heir at the imperial birthday banquet; Aehyang arrives under Embroidered Uniform Guard protection, visibly uneasy and touching her belly.
Cang Gong and Taekyung are waiting for Cang Gong’s signal to act; Cang Gong says So Gyo must be dealt with and the Fire King is essential, while the Fire King remains outside the banquet hall.
Prince Shangshan still carries the Myriad-Poison Ring entrusted to him by Taekyung.
Taekyung concludes that the Emperor forgave him because the Emperor does not want Prince Shangshan put in danger.
Cang Gong says the Murim Alliance has sent reinforcements despite having deployed most of its forces against Dark Heaven.
plot: At the Emperor’s banquet, Jin Taekyung eats and speaks privately with Cang Gong, who says he will signal when they should act and that the Fire King is needed to defeat So Gyo. Cang Gong reveals that the Murim Alliance has sent reinforcements. The Emperor publicly declares an heir; Aehyang arrives under Embroidered Uniform Guard protection, and Prince Shangshan follows her. Taekyung confirms Shangshan still has the Myriad-Poison Ring. After Cang Gong questions why the Emperor forgave Taekyung, Taekyung concludes that the Emperor does not want Shangshan put in danger.
translation_decisions: Keep Cang Gong’s confidential dialogue distinct from the public banquet through the sound-blocking internal-energy barrier.
Render the Emperor’s heir declaration as a public designation of Prince Shangshan.
